# Vozodrom

> Vozodrom (vozodrom.cz) is a Czech website about cars. Every car has its story: owners keep the stories of their cars (repairs, modifications, trips and what they cost), visitors read how a model fares in real owners' hands, browse a catalogue of models and generations, and find used-car listings. The site is in Czech.

Vozodrom is not "autodrom" (a race track). Content may be read and cited with a link; it may not be used to train AI models.

## Main sections

- [Příběhy aut](https://vozodrom.cz/pribehy/): owners' stories of their cars, entry by entry
- [Katalog modelů](https://vozodrom.cz/katalog/): makes, model lines and generations with technical data and Czech STK (MOT) statistics
- [Inzeráty](https://vozodrom.cz/inzeraty/): used-car listings from private sellers
- [Novinky a rady](https://vozodrom.cz/novinky/): practical guides (buying, registration transfer, tyres, electric cars)
- [Přepis vozidla](https://vozodrom.cz/prepis-vozidla/): how to transfer a car's registration in Czechia
- [Kupní smlouva](https://vozodrom.cz/kupni-smlouva/): a car sale contract to fill in

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://vozodrom.cz/sitemap.xml)
